Name: Candy Cane Crops -  Winter
Author: lunightmare
Description:
[size=6][i][center][b]~ Candy Cane Crops ~[/b][/center][/i][/size][center][size=4][i]Merry Christmas!![/i]

[/size]I really really needed to make this mod
for this christmas! 
It will add two crops to the game, red and green candy cane.
They are only avaliable on winter!
You'll need spacecore for it to work.

In Pierre's shop you can find red and green candies
If you plant them, the candy canes will grow <3

Hope you like it and have a nice december!
<3[/center]
[size=5][i][center][b]DOWNLOAD INSTRUCTIONS[/b][/center]

[/i][/size][size=3]· Download the mod in "Files".[/size]
[size=3]· Once downloaded, extract de zip file, it has a folder inside with the name of the mod.
[size=3]· Place it in your "Mods" folder, located in your Stardew Valley folder.[/size][/size]
[size=3]· Run your game through SMAPI.
[/size][size=3]· Have fun![/size]


[i][size=4][u][b]By:  ~ Luna ~[/b][/u][/size][/i]
